map.为什么样本到一定数量后收益变小？: Why do returns diminish once the sample reaches a certain size?
map.因为误差与 √n 成反比：样本从 100 增到 400，误差减半；但要再减半就得: Because the error is inversely proportional to √n: going from 100 to 400 responses halves it, but halving it again requires going up to 1600. Doubling precision takes four times the sample, while cost grows linearly. In practice that is why teams settle somewhere between 1000 and 2000 responses instead of simply adding more.
